reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: Currently, CDC and FMO are in the process of structuring a follow up to the Myanmar Enabling Investments Program (MEIP), the objective of which is to support its portfolio in Myanmar and preserve current and expected impact from its investments in Myanmar. The funding objective for MEIP+ is to engage a local consultant with a network in and deep knowledge of Myanmar to support FMO and CDC to i) conduct a gap assessment of FMO and CDC’s Myanmar portfolio to identify key issues and risks as well potential areas for support, potentially with other stakeholder (ii) identify the activities for a possible follow-up phase.
